Shanghai, Chine – Le Mobile World Congre: Shanghai, China – Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026, to be held in Shanghai from June 15 to 18, is establishing itself as a key event for smart mobility players. This year, the Formula E Gen3 EVO and 5G will play a central role, offering a concrete glimpse into the technologies that will shape the future of transport, including in Algeria.
La Formule E Gen3 EVO : un banc d’essai: Formula E Gen3 EVO: a testbed for tomorrow's mobility
Pour la première fois, la Formule E inté: For the first time, Formula E will feature a dedicated smart mobility zone at MWC26 Shanghai. The Gen3 EVO, the discipline's latest creation, will serve as a full-scale laboratory to test critical technologies such as autonomous driving (Levels L2 to L4), ultra-low latency telemetry, and real-time communication systems. These innovations, already deployed on a large scale in China where more than 60% of new vehicles are equipped with L2 driving assistance, could inspire Algerian manufacturers and operators.

This demonstration resonates particularly in Algeria, where telecom operators (Mobilis, Djezzy, Ooredoo) are investing in 5G networks and connected infrastructure.
